Ayana Heights

Condominium in Layan / Bang Tao
HomeSaleAyana Heights

Marketing images from the developer website, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Listed as AYANA Heights Seaview Residence, a development of 24 low-rise buildings of up to seven storeys by T.H. Group Phuket, the company behind Ayana Soluna Villas. The property portal records 549 units; other sources quote far fewer, so the total is not firm.

The project is near Horse Club Layan Beach on Rural Road 4018, in Choeng Thale, about 1.4 km from Layan Beach. Layouts run from studios of 37 sqm to three-bedroom apartments of about 113 sqm.

Facilities include a pool, gym, sauna, yoga area, co-working space, indoor kids zone and garden. Portal completion date is June 2027; the developer site and other sources give different dates.

Ayana Heights: key facts

  • Ayana Heights is a sea-view condominium in Layan, Phuket, developed by T.H. Group Phuket Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 37–113 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Jun 2027.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,500,000.
  • Nearest beach: Layan Beach (1.4 km / 2 minutes, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Thalang Hospital (4.4 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (8.3 km, straight line); Makro (4.0 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (4.2 km, straight line).
  • More projects by T.H. Group Phuket in our catalogue: AYANA Commons, AYANA SOLUNA VILLAS.
